title: Crispy Caramel Croissant Waffle (Croffle)
hookLine: Only 3 ingredients! Shattering amber caramelized sugar shell around flaky croissant layers.

items.name: Coarse pearl or turbinado raw sugar

steps.title: Heat Oil & Prep Cooling Rack
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour neutral frying oil into a heavy pot to 2 inches deep and heat steadily to 350°F (175°C). Set a wire cooling rack over paper towels nearby and measure out {croissants} and {pearl_sugar} so everything is ready to fry cleanly.

steps.title: Coat Croissant Dough in Raw Sugar
steps.instructionTemplate: Roll {croissants} generously in {pearl_sugar}, pressing sugar crystals lightly into the pastry butter layers. Gently press the coating onto every side so it adheres evenly, then let excess drip off before transferring to a clean tray.

steps.title: Press in Waffle Iron Until Glassy
steps.instructionTemplate: Press in a preheated waffle iron for 4–5 minutes until sugar melts into a glassy amber caramel crust. Rest 60 seconds to harden crunch, then crown with {whip_cream}.
steps.creatorSecret: Wait 60 seconds on a cooling rack before biting—the molten sugar turns into a shattering crème-brûlée crust!

steps.title: Drain Crisp, Toss & Serve Fresh
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer to the wire rack to drain excess oil for 1–2 minutes while still piping hot, then finish with {whip_cream}. Serve Crispy Caramel Croissant Waffle (Croffle) fresh while the exterior is shatteringly crisp.

ugcQuotes.quote: Game changer breakfast. Crispy exterior, airy layers inside!
